content.comment_body: Hello, our final year project team is encountering an issue with the analogue interface of [product_name] and a load cell. We adjusted the voltage from 0 to 10V, but when we use the analogue threshold trigger function, the simulation works smoothly when [article_no] hardware is selected in [product_name] [version_no], yet the logic doesn't transfer to the actual device. When simulated with [article_no], the output is inconsistent and erratic, though it does transfer to the device. We also tried using [product_name] [version_no], but the problem remains.

Hello [user_name], I've reproduced the issue you described. Have you checked whether the behavior is the same on the actual hardware? It might be a simulation-specific problem rather than something occurring on the physical device. Regards, [user_name]

We need assistance with connecting a load cell to the analog [product_name] (AM2). We're using two beam load cells for material weighing. The analog module accepts a voltage input of -10 to 10V; therefore, we're utilizing op-amp 741 summing amplifiers to combine the load cell outputs and amplify the voltage. The amplifier outputs a current of 3mA, and we connect its ground to M1 and the output to U1. Is this wiring correct? If there's a simpler method, please advise. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing challenges with analog signal integration between load cells and [product_name] modules using [product_name] software. Simulated results differ depending on hardware versions and software settings. The process of transferring programming logic from simulation to physical devices is unreliable, and inconsistent outputs are reported. A lack of clear documentation and technical support for proper analog wiring and signal handling is apparent.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect device simulations to mirror real-world hardware behavior accurately and for program logic to be smoothly transferable from software to device. Reliable analog signal processing from load cells is desired, alongside clear guidance and documentation regarding wiring, amplification, and integration with the analog module.
